mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (as of t-1mo) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to the expectation of continued monetary accommodation supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1550 thousand units (as of t-2mo) signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market prices in continued economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1550.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 6.5%) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates continued corporate earnings growth.
regime_hint: strong economic supply and labor conditions
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 100 AND UNRATE < 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 260), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative forward 20-day returns due to the market pricing in the risk of aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to the market pricing in reduced corporate earnings growth and increased risk of recession.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 105 (as of t-2mo) signals strengthening economic supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as the market anticipates continued economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) and a stagnant federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals an economy at risk of persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market prices in the risk of aggressive monetary tightening.
regime_hint: high inflation and stagnant monetary policy regime
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 260 AND FEDFUNDS <= 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: In strong housing market regimes (HOUST > 1550), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward 60-day returns as the market prices in continued economic expansion and rising consumer confidence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1550.
